_comment: ngsolve hdivdiv#7 (HDivDiv has no pointwise div(div(tau))). Verified 2026-08-03 on NGSolve 6.2.2604. ngs.div(tau) on an HDivDiv proxy is fine and has dims [2]; applying div a second time raises a plain Python Exception whose str() is exactly 'cannot form div', and it raises while BUILDING the expression -- before SymbolicBFI sees it -- so 'a += div(div(tau))*ww*dx' fails on the same message. The documented replacement (InnerProduct(tau, ww.Operator('hesse')) plus the normal-normal moment integral over dx(element_boundary=True)) assembles and, with M_nn=0 on HDivDiv, reproduces the Navier simply-supported value to 0.023%.
